newsitem.title: UK: UK preliminary Q3 GDP up 0.8 pct vs Q2.
newsitem.headline: UK preliminary Q3 GDP up 0.8 pct vs Q2.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics released the following preliminary UK gross domestic product data for the third quarter of 1996. Data as last reported in brackets -
NOTE - Q2 GDP forecast up 0.7 quarter on quarter and up 2.3 percent year on year.
GDP EXCLUDING OIL AND GAS EXTRACTION.
The ONS said it was estimated that the output of the production industries has grown slightly more strongly in the third quarter due to higher levels of manufacturing output.

It said that service sector output has grown at a similar rate to that in the previous quarter despite lower growth in distribution and catering industries. Finance and business services have continued to show the strongest growth.
The next estimate of third quarter GDP will be published on November 21, when hard data are available for income and expenditure.
A full set of national accounts will be issued on December 20 while preliminary fourth quarter GDP will be released on January 27, the ONS said.
